name: huly
description: Huly for Even Keel sessions: the huly MCP server and skills to work a task, split it into subtasks and put a repository on the tracker. The session reads its task itself, so turn Even Keel's brief off for the project ("brief": false) — or it reads the task twice. Credentials come from the environment: HULY_URL, HULY_WORKSPACE and HULY_TOKEN (or HULY_EMAIL and HULY_PASSWORD).
